title: SB2388 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-30; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514142153 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2388.pdf (LegiScan doc 2907449))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-01-30); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new subsection in TCA 39-17-1316): ( ) A gun dealer shall not deliver to a purchaser a trigger crank, bump stock, bump-fire device, or any other part, combination of parts, component, device, attachment, or accessory that is designed or functions to accelerate the rate of fire of a firearm until seventy-two (72) hours have passed from the initial time at which the sale of the firearm accessory was sought by the purchaser;
